title: Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
title_zh: 具有隐式动力学的层次化世界模型

paragraphs.en: Planning with world models enables test-time adaptation for embodied agents, offering superior generalization over direct policy learning. However, long-horizon tasks remain hindered by cumulative errors and search complexity. Existing hierarchical methods often use rigid macro-actions or latent skills, leading to brittle representations and limited fine-grained control. We introduce ID-WM (Implicit Dynamics World Models) , a hierarchical world model that decouples state-space reachability from local control. Our framework utilizes a high-level model to sample feasible transitions across the state manifold and a low-level world model as an inverse dynamics solver to ground these transitions into precise actions. This allows the planner to identify reachable subgoals without being constrained by low-level execution details. By prioritizing local physical feasibility over global behavioral patterns, ID-WM synthesizes novel long-horizon plans from short segments, transcending the specific behavioral modes seen during training. We demonstrate its effectiveness across three navigation and manipulation suites, achieving a 38.5% improvement over state-of-the-art policy and diffusion-based planners. Crucially, by leveraging this hierarchical structure to mitigate compounding errors, our approach yields a 135% performance gain over single-level world model MPC, particularly in complex, unseen configurations for long-horizon tasks. Videos can be viewed at https://id-wm.github.io .

paragraphs.en: World models (WM) [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] have emerged as a powerful paradigm for embodied decision-making [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] . By learning predictive models of environment dynamics, they enable test-time reasoning and the synthesis of novel behaviors for unseen goals by searching in the action space [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] . However, planning with WMs faces two fundamental challenges: 1) search complexity grows exponentially with planning horizon, and 2) prediction errors accumulate over long rollouts. Therefore, most WM-based planners are restricted to short-horizon tasks [ 8 , 9 ] , rely on simplified action abstractions [ 10 ] , or operate in high-level spaces such as language, sacrificing fine-grained control [ 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型 [1, 2, 3] 已成为具身决策 [4, 5, 6, 7] 的一种强大范式。 通过学习环境动力学的预测模型，它们能够在测试时进行推理，并通过在动作空间中搜索来为未见目标合成新行为 [8, 9, 10, 11]。 然而，使用世界模型进行规划面临两个根本性挑战：1) 搜索复杂度随规划时域呈指数级增长，2) 预测误差在长时程推演中不断累积。 因此，大多数基于世界模型的规划器仅限于短时域任务 [8, 9]，依赖简化的动作抽象 [10]，或在语言等高层空间中运行，从而牺牲了细粒度控制 [12]。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical learning offers a principled solution to this scalability challenge by decomposing long-horizon problems into manageable abstractions [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . It has been extensively studied in Reinforcement Learning (RL) [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 ] , where hierarchy mitigates the credit assignment problem in long trajectories, and in imitation learning [ 20 , 21 ] , where it enables reusable behaviors. More recently, hierarchical structure has been introduced into diffusion-based planners to avoid directly modeling entire trajectories [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] , improving scalability and generalization beyond fixed-horizon training data.
paragraphs.zh: 分层学习通过将长时程问题分解为可管理的抽象，为这一可扩展性挑战提供了一种有原则的解决方案 [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] 。 分层学习在强化学习（RL） [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 ] 中已被广泛研究，其中分层结构缓解了长轨迹中的信用分配问题；在模仿学习 [ 20 , 21 ] 中，它则实现了可复用的行为。 最近，分层结构被引入基于扩散的规划器中，以避免直接建模整条轨迹 [ 22 , 23 , 24 ] ，从而提升超出固定时程训练数据的可扩展性与泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: How can we enable the same capabilities for task-agnostic world models, enabling long-horizon zero-shot planning for unseen goals? A direct approach would be to simply increase the prediction horizon or action abstraction (e.g., frame-skipping) [ 25 ] . However, previous attempts at hierarchical world models typically depend on task-specific priors to function effectively, relying on pre-trained skills and low-level policies [ 26 , 19 ] or rewards and value functions to verify subgoal feasibility [ 27 , 28 ] . This dependency arises because planning is fundamentally adversarial: without these anchoring constraints, a powerful optimizer will inevitably exploit deficiencies in a learned world model, discovering "wormholes" or unrealistic transitions [ 29 , 30 ] . To make hierarchical world models suitable for planning, we must construct a latent space that both condenses trajectory information to minimize search complexity, and remains inherently well-behaved to prevent the planner from exploiting unrealistic transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们如何能为任务无关的世界模型赋予同样的能力，实现对未见目标的长时间跨度零样本规划？ 一种直接的方法是简单地增加预测时间跨度或动作抽象（例如跳帧）[ 25 ]。 然而，以往对层级世界模型的尝试通常依赖任务特定的先验才能有效运作，即依赖预训练技能和低层策略 [ 26 , 19 ]，或依赖奖励和价值函数来验证子目标的可行性 [ 27 , 28 ]。 这种依赖源于规划在本质上是对抗性的：缺少这些锚定约束时，强大的优化器将不可避免地利用习得世界模型中的缺陷，发现「虫洞」或不真实的转移 [ 29 , 30 ]。 为了使层级世界模型适合规划，我们必须构建一个潜空间，它既能浓缩轨迹信息以降低搜索复杂度，又天然保持良好性质，防止规划器利用不真实的转移。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we introduce ID-WM , a hierarchical world model with implicit dynamics grounded in the insight that effective planning requires decoupling topological reachability from execution details ( Figure 1 ). ID-WM consists of a high-level diffusion-based world model that only implicitly models the dynamics by outputting states that are within a fixed distance away from the current state, functioning as a neighboring state generator , and a deterministic low-level model conditioned on both current state and action, acting as an inverse dynamics solver . Conditioned on the current state and a Gaussian noise, the high-level model leverages the generative power of diffusion to map a tractable unit Gaussian latent space to the manifold of feasible neighboring states. This formulation allows us to treat the noise as an implicit high-level action, enabling the planner to search over a well-behaved distribution instead of complex, discontinuous skill spaces to reason purely about "where to go," while the low-level model recovers the precise executable actions for "how to get there."
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出 ID-WM，一种具有隐式动力学的分层世界模型，其核心洞察是：有效的规划需要将拓扑可达性与执行细节解耦（图 1）。 ID-WM 由两部分组成：一个是基于扩散的高层世界模型，它仅隐式地建模动力学，通过输出距当前状态固定距离范围内的状态来充当邻近状态生成器；另一个是以当前状态和动作为条件的确定性低层模型，充当逆动力学求解器。 以当前状态和高斯噪声为条件，高层模型利用扩散模型的生成能力，将一个易于处理的单位高斯隐空间映射到可行邻近状态流形上。 这种建模方式使我们能够将噪声视为一种隐式的高层动作，让规划器在一个性质良好的分布上进行搜索，而不是在复杂、不连续的技能空间中搜索，从而只专注于推理“去哪里”，而低层模型则恢复出“如何到达那里”的精确可执行动作。

paragraphs.en: We summarize our contributions as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们总结我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We introduce ID-WM , a hierarchical world model that decouples reachability from control, eliminating the need for task-specific value functions or pre-trained policies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了ID-WM，这是一种分层世界模型，它将可达性与控制解耦，从而无需任务特定的价值函数或预训练策略。

paragraphs.en: We propose a corresponding hierarchical planning algorithm that bridges high-level abstraction with local dynamics, enabling robust, long-horizon decision-making.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了相应的分层规划算法，该算法将高层抽象与局部动态相衔接，实现鲁棒的长时域决策。

paragraphs.en: Across three navigation and manipulation environment suites, ID-WM shows 38.5% improvement for reaching arbitrary goals against powerful hierarchical offline reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and diffusion planning methods, and crucially, a 135% improvement over single-level world model and planning regimes.
paragraphs.zh: 在三个导航与操作环境套件中，ID-WM 在到达任意目标方面相比强大的分层离线强化学习、模仿学习和扩散规划方法提升了 38.5%，更关键的是，相比单层世界模型与规划机制提升了 135%。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical learning has long been a foundational pursuit in artificial intelligence, decomposing long-horizon problems into manageable abstractions [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . This paradigm spans policy architectures [ 31 ] , reinforcement learning [ 16 , 18 , 32 , 27 ] , imitation learning [ 20 ] , and planning [ 33 , 28 ] . Existing work focuses on both behavioral (skills/options) [ 14 , 26 , 19 , 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 ] and subgoal-centric approaches [ 38 , 28 , 17 ] . However, these methods typically rely on coupled priors, such as rewards, learned value functions or pre-trained low-level policies [ 28 , 32 ] to ensure feasibility, limiting generalization beyond the training distribution. In contrast, we eliminate this dependency, enabling robust hierarchical reasoning purely through implicit dynamics even when reliable value functions and policies are absent.

paragraphs.en: World models [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] have emerged as a foundational paradigm for embodied decision-making, enabling agents to reason about the future consequences of their actions. Recently, the field has shifted towards developing general-purpose world models [ 39 , 8 , 10 , 40 , 41 , 5 ] capable of capturing broad environmental dynamics, diverging from traditional model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) where learning task-specific reward or value functions is paramount [ 42 , 43 , 44 , 45 , 46 , 47 , 48 ] . Once these dynamics are learned, inference-time planning algorithms like the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) [ 49 ] or gradient descent—are employed to derive behaviors zero-shot [ 8 , 9 , 50 , 11 ] . However, the effectiveness of these approaches is often constrained to short horizons due to the computational complexity of search and the accumulation of prediction errors over time. Consequently, they struggle with long-horizon task solving, remaining susceptible to local minima and limited in their scalability to complex behaviors. Concurrently, HWM [ 25 ] builds a hierarchical latent world model by increasing the high-level frameskip and learning macro-actions; in contrast, ID-WM searches over the diffusion noise space, which is smooth and well-conditioned by construction.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion probabilistic models [ 53 , 54 , 55 ] excel at capturing complex, multimodal distributions via iterative denoising. Their efficacy is proven across high-dimensional modalities, including pixels [ 56 , 57 , 40 , 41 ] , language [ 58 ] , and robot actions [ 59 , 60 ] . Recently, diffusion models have been proposed as zero-shot planners for embodied tasks [ 61 , 62 , 63 , 64 ] . These methods model entire trajectories directly, limiting generalization to out-of-distribution initial-goal pairs and constraining planning horizons to those seen during training. While hierarchical formulations mitigate these constraints, they rely on task-specific value functions [ 22 , 32 , 23 ] , successful task trajectories [ 65 ] , or assumed access to low-level primitives [ 24 ] . In contrast, we redefine diffusion as a local generator rather than a global planner . By delegating long-horizon reasoning to search, our method composes local jumps into novel trajectories without requiring task-specific priors.

paragraphs.en: For all environments and baselines, we randomly sample 50 pairs of initial and goal states, with sampling method detailed in Section 6.2 , and report the average performance across these instances. For the PushT task, we report two metrics: the success rate and the final coverage of the T-block relative to the target configuration. A trial is considered successful only if both the agent and the T-block reach their respective goal positions. In contrast, the final coverage metric provides a more granular measure of performance by focusing specifically on the object’s alignment. To further evaluate generalization capabilities, we test PushT under two settings: a standard regime and a data-augmented regime featuring random spatial transformations and rotations. All experiments are conducted with a maximum horizon of 2000 environment steps. For all experiments, ID-WM uses Δ = 5 \Delta=5 (25 environment steps with frameskip) and H h ​ i = 5 H_{hi}=5 subgoals per high-level plan, without per-task tuning; the planner replans after each executed plan (up to 15 replans), so no prior knowledge of the goal distance is required. We ablate Δ \Delta and the number of subgoals in Section 6.7 .

paragraphs.en: In Table 1 , ID-WM outperforms all baselines, achieving a 38.5% overall improvement and 135% gain over single-level WM with MPC (SL-WM). The gap is most evident in PushT with random goals, where ID-WM is the only approach exceeding a 30% success rate without augmentation. While SL-WM performs well on shorter horizons (Maze, Wall), it fails on PushT’s long-horizon requirements (often > 100 >100 steps) due to exponential search complexity and compounding prediction errors. Unlike the 25-step benchmark in Zhou et al. [8] , our results show that standard WM planning cannot solve these extended tasks, a limitation our hierarchical approach effectively addresses. We visualize the resulting high-level plans in Figure 5 and examine subgoal quality and diversity in Sections 4.3 and 6.12 .
paragraphs.zh: 在表1中，ID-WM 优于所有基线方法，总体提升38.5%，相比采用MPC的单层世界模型（SL-WM）提升135%。 这一差距在带随机目标的 PushT 任务中最为明显，ID-WM 是唯一在未使用数据增强的情况下成功率超过30%的方法。 虽然 SL-WM 在较短时域的任务（Maze、Wall）上表现良好，但由于指数级搜索复杂度和预测误差的累积，它无法满足 PushT 的长时域要求（通常超过100步）。 与 Zhou 等人 [8] 中25步的基准不同，我们的结果表明标准世界模型规划无法解决这些扩展任务，而我们的分层方法有效解决了这一局限。 我们在图5中可视化了由此得到的高层计划，并在第4.3节和第6.12节中考察子目标的质量与多样性。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, the remaining baselines exhibit distinct failure modes. GCBC performs well on in-distribution goals (e.g., fixed-goal PushT) and in environments with dense data coverage (Medium Maze, Wall) but degrades significantly on out-of-distribution (OOD) goals. HIQL shows potential for OOD generalization but demands dense data coverage to accurately learn value functions, reflected in its performance gap between PushT and PushT-Aug. Diffuser-based methods struggle with dataset noise; despite adding replanning ( Section 6.11.8 ), performance remains poor. While H-Diffuser offers marginal improvements, it still relies heavily on dense data. Even with data augmentation ( Section 6.3 ), H-Diffuser’s success rate remains low, primarily because it struggles to jointly attend to both the object and the agent’s final position.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，其余基线方法表现出各自不同的失败模式。 GCBC 在分布内目标（如固定目标的 PushT）以及数据覆盖密集的环境（Medium Maze、Wall）中表现良好，但在分布外（OOD）目标上性能显著下降。 HIQL 在 OOD 泛化方面显示出潜力，但需要密集的数据覆盖才能准确学习价值函数，这体现在其在 PushT 和 PushT-Aug 之间的性能差距上。 基于 Diffuser 的方法难以应对数据集中的噪声；尽管增加了重规划（第 6.11.8 节），性能仍然很差。 虽然 H-Diffuser 带来了微小的改进，但它仍然严重依赖密集数据。 即使进行数据增强（第 6.3 节），H-Diffuser 的成功率仍然较低，主要原因是它难以同时关注物体和智能体的最终位置。

paragraphs.en: Unlike approaches that explicitly model dataset behavior, ID-WM is not constrained by the underlying training distribution. By leveraging full planning over the environment dynamics, our method is inherently capable of finding diverse solutions for a given goal. Figure 6 demonstrates this by showing two different subgoal sequences generated by ID-WM . For instance, Plan 1 (top row) rotates the T-block counterclockwise, while Plan 2 (bottom row) rotates it clockwise. Ultimately, both planned trajectories successfully achieve the final objective via our hierarchical framework.
paragraphs.zh: 与显式建模数据集行为的方法不同，ID-WM 不受底层训练分布的约束。 通过对环境动力学进行完整规划，我们的方法天生能够为给定目标找到多样化的解决方案。 图 6 展示了由 ID-WM 生成的两个不同子目标序列来说明这一点。 例如，方案 1（上排）将 T 形块逆时针旋转，而方案 2（下排）将其顺时针旋转。 最终，两条规划轨迹都通过我们的分层框架成功实现了最终目标。

sents.en: Unlike approaches that explicitly model dataset behavior, ID-WM is not constrained by the underlying training distribution.
sents.zh: 与显式建模数据集行为的方法不同，ID-WM 不受底层训练分布的约束。

sents.en: By leveraging full planning over the environment dynamics, our method is inherently capable of finding diverse solutions for a given goal.
sents.zh: 通过对环境动力学进行完整规划，我们的方法天生能够为给定目标找到多样化的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Scaling with Maze Size. Each dataset contains 2,000 random 100-step trajectories. Given a fixed dataset size, data coverage naturally becomes sparser as maze size increases.

paragraphs.en: While all methods achieve near-perfect success on the U-Maze, baselines degrade significantly in larger environments ( Figure 7 a). In contrast, ID-WM maintains the highest performance on the Large Maze. We hypothesize this is because ID-WM combines local dynamics modeling with high-level planning, effectively "stitching" together regions of sparse data. Unlike GCBC or Diffuser (which model entire trajectories simultaneously) or HIQL (which requires dense data for global value functions), ID-WM does not rely on global trajectory coverage. Furthermore, while H-Diffuser uses abstraction, it lacks an explicit dynamics model, resulting in brittle plans requiring expensive, high-frequency replanning. By grounding its hierarchy in explicit local dynamics, ID-WM generates robust, scalable plans.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然所有方法在 U 形迷宫上都能取得近乎完美的成功率，但在更大的环境中，基线方法的性能显著下降（图 7a）。 相比之下，ID-WM 在大型迷宫中保持了最高的性能。 我们推测这是因为 ID-WM 将局部动力学建模与高层规划相结合，有效地将稀疏数据的区域“拼接”在一起。 与 GCBC 或 Diffuser（它们同时建模整条轨迹）或 HIQL（它需要稠密数据来构建全局价值函数）不同，ID-WM 并不依赖于全局轨迹覆盖。 此外，尽管 H-Diffuser 使用了抽象，但它缺乏显式的动力学模型，导致其规划脆弱，需要代价高昂的高频重规划。 通过将它的层次结构建立在显式的局部动力学之上，ID-WM 能够生成鲁棒且可扩展的规划。

paragraphs.en: We present ID-WM , a hierarchical world modeling and planning framework that decouples temporally extended subgoal generation from local reachability. By treating diffusion noise as implicit actions, we constrain the planning search space to a unit Gaussian, ensuring reliable subgoal generation. ID-WM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and demonstrates high-quality vision-based subgoal generation. Ultimately, grounding hierarchical abstraction in explicit local dynamics represents a promising step toward robust, long-horizon decision-making.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ID-WM，一个分层世界建模与规划框架，它将时间上扩展的子目标生成与局部可达性解耦。 通过将扩散噪声视为隐式动作，我们将规划搜索空间约束在单位高斯分布内，从而确保可靠的子目标生成。 ID-WM 显著优于最先进的基线方法，并展示了高质量的基于视觉的子目标生成。 最终，将分层抽象建立在显式局部动力学之上，是迈向鲁棒长时程决策的一个有前景的步骤。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. First, ID-WM ’s reliance on search-based optimization within a diffusion latent space incurs higher inference times than reactive policies or deterministic world models. Future work will explore amortized or gradient-based planning to mitigate this bottleneck. Second, while our hierarchy prevents planning complexity from scaling with trajectory length, it still scales with state-space dimensionality. Integrating compact, structured representation learning could further streamline this planning process for highly complex environments.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 首先，ID-WM 依赖于在扩散潜空间内进行基于搜索的优化，导致其推理时间高于反应式策略或确定性世界模型。 未来工作将探索摊销式或基于梯度的规划，以缓解这一瓶颈。 其次，虽然我们的层级结构使规划复杂度不会随轨迹长度增长，但其复杂度仍会随状态空间维度增长。 整合紧凑的结构化表示学习，可进一步为高度复杂的环境简化这一规划过程。

paragraphs.en: PushT: Introduced by Chi et al. [59] , this environment consists of a pusher agent and a T-shaped block. The objective is for both the agent and the block to reach specified target locations from random initial positions. We evaluate two variants of this task: in Fix Goal , the target state is a fixed configuration (the green T); in Random Goal , the target is randomly sampled from the environment’s state space. Both settings are significantly more challenging than the formulation in Zhou et al. [8] , where the goal is provided at a known, fixed horizon of 25 steps. In contrast, completing the task in our settings often requires hundreds of steps, rendering standard single-level planning infeasible. Following [ 8 ] , we train on noisy, replayed trajectories. We further evaluate our method in a data-abundant regime by applying random translation and rotation augmentations to the existing dataset.

paragraphs.en: Goal-conditioned Behavior Cloning (GCBC): An imitation learning paradigm where a policy is trained to map the current state and a target goal observation directly to the expert action that leads toward that goal. For our implementation, we extend Diffusion Policy [ 59 ] by conditioning the policy on a future frame randomly sampled from the trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 目标条件行为克隆（GCBC）：一种模仿学习范式，其中策略被训练为将当前状态和目标观测直接映射到通向该目标的专家动作。 在我们的实现中，我们通过将策略条件化于从轨迹中随机采样的未来帧来扩展 Diffusion Policy [ 59 ]。

paragraphs.zh: Diffuser [ 61 ]：一种轨迹级扩散模型，通过采样完整的状态-动作序列来执行规划。 我们在环境中执行每个动作后重新规划。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical Diffuser [ 23 ] : An extension of Diffuser that decomposes the planning process into two temporal scales. We replan both the high level and the low level after executing each action in the environment.

paragraphs.en: To assess sensitivity to these choices, we sweep Δ \Delta and the number of subgoals on PushT-Aug with random goals ( Table 4 ). Performance is robust for large Δ \Delta across a wide range of subgoal counts. For a fixed effective search horizon ( Δ × \Delta\times number of subgoals), splitting it evenly between the two levels is most effective: at an effective horizon of roughly 25, the success rate increases monotonically from 0.06 ( Δ = 1 \Delta=1 , 25 subgoals) to 0.96 ( Δ = 5 \Delta=5 , 5 subgoals). A very small Δ \Delta pushes the burden onto a long subgoal chain while contributing little per hop.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估对这些选择的敏感性，我们在带随机目标的 PushT-Aug 上对 Δ \Delta 和子目标数量进行了扫描（表 4）。 在大范围的子目标数量下，较大的 Δ \Delta 都能保持稳健的性能。 对于固定的有效搜索范围（Δ × \Delta\times 子目标数量），在两个层级之间均匀分配最为有效：在有效搜索范围约为 25 时，成功率从 0.06（Δ = 1 \Delta=1，25 个子目标）单调提升至 0.96（Δ = 5 \Delta=5，5 个子目标）。 过小的 Δ \Delta 会把负担压到较长的子目标链条上，而每跳的贡献却很小。

paragraphs.en: Success rate measures whether a goal is reached but not how efficiently. To quantify trajectory efficiency, we report the average number of environment steps to success for all methods on PushT-Aug (Random Goal) and Medium Maze in Table 5 , computed over successful trajectories only (N/A if no trajectory succeeded). ID-WM is the most efficient method on PushT-Aug and the most efficient among value-function-free methods on Medium Maze. HIQL’s learned value function yields substantially shorter maze paths, reflecting a trade-off: the planning cost in Section 3.2 is the distance between the last imagined state and the goal, which optimizes for reaching the goal rather than for path efficiency. Within the same framework, a self-supervised value function could be substituted for this cost to improve path optimality.
paragraphs.zh: 成功率衡量目标是否达成，但不衡量效率高低。 为了量化轨迹效率，我们在表5中报告了所有方法在 PushT-Aug (Random Goal) 和 Medium Maze 上成功所需的平均环境步数，仅对成功的轨迹进行统计（若没有轨迹成功则为 N/A）。 ID-WM 是 PushT-Aug 上最高效的方法，也是 Medium Maze 上无价值函数方法中最高效的方法。 HIQL 学到的价值函数能得到明显更短的迷宫路径，这体现了一种权衡：3.2节中的规划代价是最后一个想象状态与目标之间的距离，它优化的是到达目标而非路径效率。 在同一框架内，可以用自监督的价值函数替代该代价，以提升路径的最优性。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 reports the wall-clock inference time to reach one goal for each method in the state-based setting, measured on a single NVIDIA L40S GPU. GCBC and HIQL are reactive policies whose compute budget cannot be adapted at test time; GCBC is comparatively slow because of its Diffusion Policy backbone. Diffuser and H-Diffuser follow their original formulation of replanning a full trajectory after every action, which is the most expensive setting. Despite running CEM at both levels, ID-WM is roughly 27 × 27\times faster than Diffuser and 54 × 54\times faster than H-Diffuser, and faster than GCBC. The only faster methods are HIQL and SL-WM, both of which fail on long-horizon tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 表7报告了在基于状态的设置下，各方法达到单个目标所需的实际推理时间，测量在一块NVIDIA L40S GPU上进行。 GCBC和HIQL是反应式策略，其计算预算无法在测试时调整；GCBC由于采用Diffusion Policy骨干网络而相对较慢。 Diffuser和H-Diffuser遵循其原始设定，即在每次执行动作后重新规划完整轨迹，这是计算开销最大的设置。 尽管在两个层级上都运行CEM，ID-WM仍比Diffuser快约27倍，比H-Diffuser快约54倍，并且快于GCBC。 唯一更快的方法是HIQL和SL-WM，但二者在长时程任务上均会失败。

paragraphs.en: Inference-time-matched SL-WM. Since SL-WM runs faster than ID-WM at the same CEM budget, we additionally match wall-clock time on PushT (Random Goal) by allowing SL-WM 45 replans ( 3 × 3\times ). As shown in Table 8 , tripling SL-WM’s replanning budget yields only a marginal improvement (0.21 to 0.28) and remains far below ID-WM (0.77). This indicates that SL-WM’s failure mode is compounding prediction error over long horizons rather than insufficient search, and that the gain comes from the hierarchy rather than from additional test-time compute.
paragraphs.zh: 推理时间对齐的 SL-WM。 由于在相同的 CEM 预算下 SL-WM 比 ID-WM 运行得更快，我们额外在 PushT（Random Goal）上匹配了实际运行时间，允许 SL-WM 进行 45 次重规划（3 × 3\times）。 如表 8 所示，将 SL-WM 的重规划预算增至三倍仅带来微小的提升（0.21 到 0.28），且仍远低于 ID-WM（0.77）。 这表明 SL-WM 的失败模式是在长时程上预测误差的累积，而非搜索不足；其收益来自层级结构，而非额外的测试时计算量。

paragraphs.en: We train our state-based world models using 1 to 8 NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPUs, utilizing Distributed Data Parallel (DDP) to accelerate training when scaling to 8 GPUs. All baseline models are trained to convergence on a single NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPU. Planning evaluations are also conducted using a single NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPU. paragraphs.en: Diffuser frames offline goal-conditioned planning as a trajectory denoising problem. A temporal U-Net processes a full trajectory τ = ( s 0 , a 0 , … , s H − 1 , a H − 1 ) \tau=(s_{0},a_{0},\ldots,s_{H-1},a_{H-1}) of planning horizon H H , and iterative reverse diffusion over T T steps is guided by goal conditioning to produce trajectories that reach a specified goal state. At inference, the current state is inpainted at the start of the trajectory and the goal state at the end; the remaining timesteps are filled by denoising. All environments share the same base configuration. Only the planning horizon H H is adjusted (in Table 17 ).

paragraphs.en: H-Diffuser [ 23 ] extends Diffuser with a two-level hierarchy. A high-level diffusion model plans jumpy subgoals spaced J J timesteps apart, producing a compressed sequence of length ⌈ H hl / J ⌉ \lceil H_{\mathrm{hl}}/J\rceil that covers a larger temporal horizon at lower computational cost. A low-level diffusion model then plans a dense trajectory of length H ll H_{\mathrm{ll}} between consecutive subgoals, conditioned on the current state and the subgoal as the terminal constraint.

paragraphs.en: The original Diffuser paper uses two execution strategies depending on the environment: for D4RL locomotion tasks, only the first action of each plan is executed and the model replans at every step ( execute one action + replan ); for maze2d and Kuka block-stacking, the full planned trajectory is executed open-loop without replanning ( execute plan ). H-Diffuser adopts the same two strategies at the subgoal level. To enable a fair comparison with our method, we additionally evaluate both models under a third strategy in which the full plan is executed and the model then replans ( execute plan + replan ). Results under all three strategies are reported in Tables 18 and 19 .
paragraphs.zh: 原始 Diffuser 论文根据环境使用两种执行策略：对于 D4RL 运动控制任务，只执行每个计划的第一个动作，模型在每一步都重新规划（执行一个动作 + 重新规划）；对于 maze2d 和 Kuka 块堆叠任务，则开环执行完整的规划轨迹而不进行重新规划（执行计划）。 H-Diffuser 在子目标层面采用相同的两种策略。 为了与我们的方法进行公平比较，我们还在第三种策略下对两个模型进行了评估，即先执行完整计划，然后模型再重新规划（执行计划 + 重新规划）。 三种策略下的结果均报告于表 18 和表 19 中。

paragraphs.en: As training begins, the predicted distributions are highly dispersed and often fail to preserve the structure of the PushT scene. In early checkpoints, the sampled futures do not consistently respect the local geometry of the object or the physically plausible displacement induced by the agent-object interaction. As training progresses, the generated samples become increasingly concentrated around coherent future configurations. By approximately 200 to 600 training steps, the model begins to capture the coarse reachable region for each temporal horizon, and later checkpoints further sharpen the predicted distribution while preserving meaningful sample diversity.
paragraphs.zh: 随着训练开始，预测的分布高度分散，且往往无法保留 PushT 场景的结构。 在早期检查点中，采样的未来并不总是符合物体的局部几何结构，或智能体与物体交互所引发的物理上合理的位移。 随着训练的推进，生成的样本越来越集中于连贯的未来构型附近。 在大约 200 到 600 个训练步时，模型开始捕捉每个时间范围内的粗略可达区域，后续检查点进一步锐化预测分布，同时保留有意义的样本多样性。

paragraphs.en: We visualize the difference between our proposed ID-WM high-level world model and a naive WM without implicit dynamics. The left column shows the sampled noise/action distribution. In Figure 12 , the middle column shows the neighboring states predicted by ID-WM , and the right column shows predictions from a naive WM with frameskip matched to the ID-WM subgoal horizon. ID-WM yields a smooth and locally consistent reachable set. The naive WM produces irregular mappings: nearby samples can jump to distant states, leave the local reachable neighborhood, or form discontinuous regions. This indicates that long-skip prediction with a naive world model is prone to out-of-distribution subgoals and discontinuous action-to-state geometry, making it less suitable for planning.
